test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.**

Getting a good night’s sleep __has a positively effect__ on our well-being.
solution: The correct answer is **'has a positive effect'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The underlined part in the given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'has a positive effect'** should be used instead of** 'has a positively effect'.** • In the given sentence adverb '**positively**' is not needed. • We know that an **adverb** is a word that adds more information about place, time, manner, cause or degree to **a verb, an adjective, a phrase or another adverb**. (समय, स्थान, कारण आदि के संबंध में अधिक जानकारी देने या क्रिया, विशेषण, वाक्यांश या अन्य क्रियाविशेषण की श्रेणी को दर्शानेवाला शब्द; क्रियाविशेषण) • *Example: In ‘**speak slowly**’, ‘**extremely funny**’, ‘**arrive late’** and ‘**I know her well**’, ‘**slowly**’, ‘**extremely**’, ‘**late**’ and ‘**well**’ are **adverbs**.* • But in the given context not any kind of **modification** is needed. Hence, '**positive**' should be used. • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.** **Correct Sentence:__** *Getting a good night's sleep **has a positive effect **on our well-being.* 39:Tb43, The correct answer is '**awful**'.
